title: Lived Experience Matters: Automatic Detection of Stigma on Social Media Toward People Who Use Substances

bias_targets.target: Bias against people who use substances (PWUS)
bias_targets.methodology: Crowdsourced annotation of Reddit comments containing substance-related keywords, followed by training a Deep and Cross Network (DCN) and using Differential Language Analysis (DLA) to identify linguistic cues (LIWC and unigrams) associated with stigmatizing language.

bias_targets.target: Annotator demographic and lived experience bias
bias_targets.methodology: Utilizing a jury learning framework to evaluate how varying the demographic composition of annotator groups (by substance use history, race, and gender) affects the perception and classification thresholds of stigmatizing content.

primary_bias_target: Bias against people who use substances (PWUS)
